title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: notice periods and claim time bar by tier
content:
## Scope

This table belongs to the Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims product line and gives, for every tier, the notice periods for loss discovered after delivery and for loss apparent at delivery, and the claim time bar.

## Tier table

| Tier | Notice period for loss not apparent at delivery | Notice period for loss apparent at delivery | Claim time bar |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Standard Carrier Liability | 3 calendar days | 0 (noted on the delivery receipt) | 12 calendar months |
| AHL Declared Value Liability | 3 calendar days | 0 (noted on the delivery receipt) | 12 calendar months |
| AHL CargoCare Essential | 7 calendar days | 0 (noted on the delivery receipt) | 12 calendar months |
| AHL CargoCare Plus | 14 calendar days | 3 calendar days | 12 calendar months |
| AHL CargoCare Premium | 21 calendar days | 3 calendar days | 18 calendar months |
| AHL CargoCare Total | 30 calendar days | 7 calendar days | 24 calendar months |

## Definitions

- **Notice period for loss not apparent at delivery**: the calendar days after delivery within which notice of loss not apparent at delivery must reach the line.
- **Notice period for loss apparent at delivery**: the calendar days after delivery within which notice of loss apparent at delivery must reach the line. A figure of 0 means the loss must be noted on the delivery receipt.
- **Claim time bar**: the calendar months after delivery after which no claim is admissible.

## Basis Q&A

**The table shows 0 for loss apparent at delivery on AHL CargoCare Essential. Does that mean no notice is possible?**
No. A figure of 0 means the loss must be noted on the delivery receipt, rather than notified within a number of days.

**Which tier allows the longest time bar?** AHL CargoCare Total, at 24 calendar months after delivery.
